import pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,json,os
repo=pathlib.Path('/Users/itayzrihan/Documents/PoCut');out=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='opencut-main-format-merge-',dir='/tmp'))
env={**os.environ,'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS':'0'}
target=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'rev-parse','codex/earshot-deepseek-integration'],env=env,text=True).strip();result=[]

 path='classic/rust/crates/timeline/src/'+name
 data={ 'base':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'show','HEAD:'+path],env=env),'local':(repo/path).read_bytes(),'target':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'show',target+':'+path],env=env)}
 for k,v in data.items():(out/(name+'.'+k)).write_bytes(v)
 merged=subprocess.run(['git','merge-file','-p',str(out/(name+'.local')),str(out/(name+'.base')),str(out/(name+'.target'))],capture_output=True)
 (out/(name+'.merged')).write_bytes(merged.stdout)
 if merged.returncode==0:
  status='clean three-way merge';same=merged.stdout==data['target']
 else:status='three-way conflicts';same=False
 result.append({'file':path,'result':status,'identicalToIncoming':same,'output':str(out/(name+'.merged'))})
print(json.dumps({'target':target,'results':result}))
